visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with short black hair and glasses is sitting on a blue couch, wearing a grey t-shirt and large over-ear headphones. He is speaking into a professional black microphone mounted on a white boom arm. The background is a simple, neutral-colored curtain. (2) The scene cuts to a young woman with her hair in a ponytail, wearing glasses, a black t-shirt, and similar headphones. She is speaking into a microphone with a wooden shelf filled with books and posters behind her. (3) The shot returns to the man on the couch, who is now gesturing with his hands while speaking. (4) The camera switches back to the woman, who appears to be listening intently and then responding with hand gestures. (5) A brief shot shows another man with long dark hair, wearing glasses and headphones, speaking from the same bookshelf background. (6) The woman is shown again, smiling and laughing while continuing to explain her point with animated hand movements. visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: 30歲好焦慮? [Subtitle]: 30歲是有什麼意義嗎? (2) [Subtitle]: 我是這一兩年開始瘋狂愛上你們的小粉絲. (3) [Subtitle]: 他說30歲好焦慮啊~ (4) [Subtitle]: 在快30歲的時候有覺得焦慮嗎? (5) [Subtitle]: 30歲是什麼時候啊? (6) [Subtitle]: 那一年我們在結婚啊~ 就是創業很忙, 又要搞結婚的東西也很忙~ (7) [Subtitle]: 就突然就過了30歲了欸. (8) [Subtitle]: 像18歲就是一個刑法成年嘛. 20歲是民法成年嘛. (9) [Subtitle]: 一般來說你就是大學畢業工作3-4年. (10) [Subtitle]: 對~ 就會覺得人生好像應該要進入一個稍微小有成就的階段嗎? (11) [Subtitle]: 是一個不再年輕的標記吧. (12) [Variety]: 哈哈哈哈哈哈. (13) [Subtitle]: 反正我是沒有覺得我30歲的時候特別的特殊感受. (14) [Subtitle]: 有時候你對未來感到焦慮是因為對不確定會發生什麼事感到焦慮嘛. (15) [Subtitle]: 那我覺得我的方法啦~ 把你要做的事情明確地列下來. (16) [Subtitle]: 一個一個照時間照順序去把它完成. (17) [Subtitle]: 你就會有打進度條的實際的感覺. (18) [Subtitle]: 其實這樣子的話, 我覺得你光把就是你未來想要做的事情就是條列式的寫下來, 列得出來的話, 其實就可以緩解焦慮的效果.
